name: @domily/next
description: Core runtime, protocol, and authoring primitives for Domily Next

scripts.build: rm -rf ./lib && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/author.ts ./src/codec.ts --bundle --outdir ./lib --target browser --format esm && bun build ./src/compiler/index.ts --bundle --outfile ./lib/compiler.js --target node --format esm --external @swc/core && tsc -b ./tsconfig.types.json --force
